low.title: Full-Day St. Wolfgang Art Route on a Low Budget
low.summary: An affordable day of scenic lakeside art, traditional architecture, and peaceful creative corners.

schedule.description: Begin the day with views of Lake Wolfgangsee and wooden lakeside architecture.

schedule.description: Walk through narrow streets with murals, wooden carvings, and small artisan displays.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Simple daily menus, stews, baked dishes, or Alpine soups.

schedule.title: Waterfront Sketch or Photo Time
schedule.description: A relaxed creative break by the lake — perfect for drawing or photography.

schedule.title: Budget Café Break

schedule.title: Sunset Art Stroll
schedule.description: Capture golden-hour reflections and colorful lake scenery.

schedule.description: Start your day with a warm drink overlooking Wolfgangsee.

schedule.title: Pilgrimage Church Interior Highlights
schedule.description: Admire altars, frescoes, and historic artwork inside the iconic church.

schedule.title: Medium-Budget Lunch
schedule.description: Comfortable Austrian dishes — hearty but not too fancy.

schedule.title: Craft Shops & Local Art Walk
schedule.description: Explore unique carvings, ceramics, and artisan storefronts.

schedule.title: Small Gallery Visit

schedule.title: Dessert Break
schedule.description: Relax with a sweet bite and scenic views.

schedule.title: Evening Reflections by the Lake

schedule.title: Premium Café Dessert

schedule.title: Golden-Hour Lakeside Study
